question: Which islands have the most penguins? Show it as a bar chart.
sql:
SELECT
  "island",
  COUNT(*) AS penguin_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    *
  FROM penguins_csv
) AS deduped
GROUP BY
  "island"
ORDER BY
  penguin_count DESC
spec:
$schema: https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json
config:
  axis:
    grid: false
  numberFormat: ',~r'
  view:
    stroke: null
data:
  name: penguin_count_by_island
height: container
layer:
- encoding:
    color:
      condition:
        test: datum.island === 'Biscoe'
        value: '#1f77b4'
      value: '#aec7e8'
    tooltip:
    - field: island
      title: Island
      type: nominal
    - field: penguin_count
      format: ',~r'
      title: Penguin Count
      type: quantitative
    x:
      axis:
        format: ',~r'
        tickMinStep: 1
        title: Penguin Count
      field: penguin_count
      type: quantitative
    y:
      axis:
        title: null
      field: island
      sort:
        field: penguin_count
        order: descending
      type: nominal
  mark: bar
title:
  subtitle: Over 3x Torgersen's count
  text: Biscoe Hosts Most Penguins, 168 Total
width: container
